assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: original illustration for Grade 10 Kenyan Biology lesson slides. Create a polished warm flat editorial illustration on a pale cream background, square composition. A Kenyan teenage girl aged 15–16, dark brown skin, black braided hair tied back, wearing a turquoise school shirt, is standing in a modest Nairobi home kitchen beside a wooden counter with a sliced red onion, chopping board and a kitchen knife lying safely flat away from her hands. She holds up one index finger with a small clean plaster, curious rather than distressed. No blood. Age appropriate secondary school illustration, not a small child. Rich simple shapes, subtle grain, teal, ochre, coral and deep navy palette, expressive face, clear silhouette, restrained background. No text, no letters, no logos, no labels, no science diagrams. Entire scene comfortably within frame. This is an original character and composition, not a copy of an existing reference.

Warm pale cream background, simple uncluttered composition, generous empty backdrop. Editorial educational illustration, flat colour shapes with gentle texture and dimensional shading, teal, ochre, coral and navy palette. Accurate recognisable microscope silhouette with eyepiece, arm, stage, objective turret, focusing knobs and base. No people, no labels, no letters, no watermark, no invented magnified cells or micrograph. Entire apparatus comfortably within frame. Atmospheric cover artwork, not an instructional diagram.

No claim that solar panels produce food: this artwork is only an analogy setting.
